issues.reason: Holder is defined as the subject of a possession / relational state and only for own / have / lack, so filling it with the PP object of "belong to" violates that definition outright, and this is not uncovered territory: the prepositional-verb rule ("referred to the memo" → (To …), never a direct-object role) plus the stative-intransitive-subject rule ("nothing changes and nothing moves" → Experiencer) already license a complete alternative.

"Near" is neither containment nor in / at / on, and the prompt states the entity-side surface-preposition licence is "the same open licence as the event-side preposition-named oblique — never a coined synonym head, always the word actually used", so (Location sk_find_1 sk_cliff_spire_1) asserts the finding happened at the spire when the text says only that it happened nearby.

The gap half stands — Ordinal's <scale> is the associated ordering event or an explicit "-est" dimension and "the third cliff-spire" supplies neither — but the defect half does not, since (Ordinal sk_cliff_spire_1 3 cliff_spire) states nothing false (it is the third among cliff-spires), uses a licensed head, and Core patterns forbids silently dropping the stated restrictive "third".

A fused compound kind's head genus is "always emitted either way" and the seal-projection table routes a sealed P's compound-decomposition atoms to top level as its second item, while the IS-A suppression bar is explicitly the idiom bar's little sibling for lexicalized compounds ("hot dog"), which a transparent novel coinage cannot be — so (Inheritance sky_cat cat) is a determined, missing atom, leaving the minted sky_cat symbol unreachable in the KB.

gaps_confirmed: Converse possession verb ("X belongs to Y", possessed as subject): Holder / Theme are defined only for possessor-subject verbs (own / have / lack), and the preposition-named oblique the rules otherwise mandate feeds no seeded derivation to the (Possession <possessed> <possessor>) form the prompt requires every possession question to query.
Enumerative ordinal ("the third cliff-spire"): Ordinal's <scale> slot has no licensed filler — no associated ordering event, no "-est" dimension, and `unspecified` is Measure-family-only.
In-world calendar date ("day 440 of Year 2"): a day-of-year count, not a day-of-month, and the Time term inventory cannot mark the difference.

"Took no action": the QuantifierPhrase companion is mandatory for every explicit quantifier word the claim consumes, but its (QuantifierPhrase <subject> <predicate> "<word>") shape has no slot for a "no" sitting on a direct object, and here no rule quantifies a range for it to restate — rightly filed as a gap rather than an issue, since an ill-shaped companion would be worse than none.
new_gaps: A novel compound kind naming an invented creature (sky_cat) gives the IS-A suppression test nothing to decide on: the bar the instruction set states is lexicalization ("a hot dog is not a dog"), which a coinage cannot exhibit, so the genus is emitted by default even where the fiction may not support it (a feathered cat) — a licensed form would need a way to mark a genus as surface-derived rather than world-verified, or a stated default for invented kinds.
defect_summary: For the belong-to roles the compliant sealed form is (Member sk_belong_1 belong) (Experiencer sk_belong_1 sk_feather_1) (To sk_belong_1 sk_skycat_1) (Might sk_belong_1), which is licensed but loses the possession relation the sentence turns on — the cost recorded in the first confirmed gap. For "near the third cliff-spire" the compliant form is the surface-preposition oblique (Near sk_find_1 sk_cliff_spire_1) in place of Location. For the compound kind, (Inheritance sky_cat cat) belongs at top level beside the seal, per the seal-projection table's second item.
notes: The seal itself is handled well: non-factive report with an Experiencer holder, Recipient for the addressee, no top-level predication of P, and the indefinite sky-cat witness correctly kept inside. One cosmetic slip the reviewer did not raise: the witness stem sk_skycat_1 does not match its minted class symbol sky_cat, which the prompt says the symbol is minted from.
